headline: GREEN, only just. No plan on the calendar, so do a free Z2 aerobic day
summary: Readiness is green, but only just. HRV is 56, against a threshold of 55 or more. It was 60 yesterday, a drop of 4, well under the 10 that would make it amber. RHR is 51, right on the 51 limit. Sleep was 6.1h, which clears the 6h line (score 76). The plan has nothing scheduled: the Valtellina block ended with the race on 7 Nov (212 load, 22.1km / 825m D+, 2h14, avg HR 172). Today and the next 14 days are blank. Since the race, load has stayed fairly steady: Barcelona 24.9km on 11 Nov (138, feel Poor), Presolana 19.6km / 1188m D+ on 15 Nov (142, RPE 8, feel Strong), then 33 / 61 / 92 on 17, 18 and 21 Nov. CTL has eased from 57.4 on race day to 50.5. ATL is 37.4, so TSB is about +13: you are fresh but losing fitness. Suggestion for today, not written into the plan: 60-75min easy run or trail at 142-155bpm, capped at 155. If RHR reads 52+ tomorrow, make that an easy day.
flags: No active training block: the plan ends 8 Nov. Use the coaching chat to point the plan at the next race (rewrite race/baseline/weeks, archive the Valtellina sessions, tag valtellina-final) so daily edits are possible again.
Easy-day drift: the 18 Nov Bucharest run averaged 156bpm, which is Z3, at RPE 4. Easy runs should stay at 155 or below.
Sleep is still the limiter: 4.8h on 18 Nov, 5.3h on 15 Nov, and a 21:57 spin last night before 6.1h of sleep with RHR at the 51 edge. Finish evening spins earlier.
CTL has slipped 6.9 points since race day (57.4 to 50.5). If the next race is close, it's time to rebuild steady volume.
